name: axentra
description: Axentra Document Management System engineering foundation

scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/worker build
scripts.type-check: bun run type-check:packages && bun run type-check:apps
scripts.type-check:packages: bun run --cwd packages/config type-check && bun run --cwd packages/shared type-check && bun run --cwd packages/observability type-check && bun run --cwd packages/db type-check && bun run --cwd packages/storage type-check && bun run --cwd packages/queue type-check
scripts.type-check:apps: bun run --cwd apps/web type-check && bun run --cwd apps/api type-check && bun run --cwd apps/worker type-check
scripts.test: bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend && bun test ./packages ./test
scripts.test:backend: bun --cwd apps/api test && bun --cwd apps/worker test
scripts.test:be-then-fe: bun run test:backend && bun run test:frontend
scripts.complete-check: bun run type-check && bun run lint && bun run fmt && bun run test && bun run build
